items.title: Full-dimensional kinetic drift dissipation in the actual source metric

source.attribution: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang; exact bounded full-dimensional drift edge only.

items.statement: For every finite-dimensional real inner-product E, kappa>=1, symmetric real linear H with (2kappa)^-1 I<=H<=I and every x,p∈E, D_H(x,p)>=Q_kappa(x,p)/(8kappa), where Q_kappa=(1/(2kappa)+1/2)||x||²+inner(x,p)+||p||² and D_H=inner(x,Hx)+2inner(p,Hx)-kappa^-1 inner(x,p)+||p||². With A_H(x,p)=(p,-Hx-p), M_kappa(x,p)=((alpha+1/2)x+p/2,x/2+p), this is exactly -2 inner(M_kappa(x,p),A_H(x,p))>=Q_kappa/(8kappa), hence the full matrix quadratic inequality (4.15). Product inner here is the sum of the two E inner products.
assumptions: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space, including dimension zero; H:E→E is a real linear map. For all v,w, inner(Hv,w)=inner(v,Hw). No supplied eigenbasis or commuting/certified H-square condition is assumed.

kappa>=1, alpha=1/(2kappa); for every v, alpha||v||²<=inner(v,Hv)<=||v||². These are the actual source symmetric operator bounds. Construction of H from genuine positive integral momentum weights belongs to Lemma4.6 and remains separate.
x,p range over all E, without probability laws, moment, measure, smoothness or integrability assumptions. The phase norm is the actual M_kappa quadratic form, not the default product max norm.

obligations.label: Full source M_kappa quadratic drift matrix inequality
Exact-gradient contraction and both main results/composition (remaining)

bindings.boundary: Only source full-dimensional drift dissipation(4.14)-(4.15). The exact-gradient kernel K difference expansion/remainder, actual averaged H producer, positivity of integral momentum weights, logarithmic Lambda and actual step adapters remain open. The private scalar and coordinate helpers share the public whole-module review and gain no separate theorem/leaf credit.
